Wake up and see what they are really doing behind the scenes. They are trying to pass this off as a mere paperwork error emerging from court documents, but that is just a cover story to hide the real operation. The lawyers for ICE were caught providing false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. Do you really think that was an accident? It is obviously a coordinated trap, meticulously designed to lure in individuals seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts. 

Now look at how they are scrambling to protect themselves and spin a new narrative now that the script got exposed. Federal prosecutors now claim that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year did not authorize the arrests, even though they had previously cited that same memo to justify them. They are only changing their tune because they got caught. They knew exactly what they were doing with that memo all along, executing a calculated move as part of their hidden agenda to maintain total control and manipulate the narrative from the shadows.
